design_vision: Money-App Grade B2B & Freelancer Invoicing Platform tailored for India's high-velocity UPI and GST ecosystem. Blends the crisp high-precision Swiss grid with India's trusted digital payment energy (Deep Indigo/Electric Saffron & Jade green accents, zero clutter, instant QR generation, GST auto-computation, and tactical scanability).

font_families.heading: Outfit, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif
font_families.body: Plus Jakarta Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif
font_families.mono_numbers: JetBrains Mono, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

scale.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
scale.currency_large: font-mono text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight

rules: Never use Inter or generic Arial for page headers or KPI summaries.
Use Mono font for Indian Rupee amounts, invoice numbers (e.g. INV-2026-0042), GSTIN, and UPI IDs for absolute numeric precision.
All major section headers must have tight tracking (tracking-tight).

guidelines: Never use pure black #000000. Use deep slate #0F172A or #1E293B.

Badges for invoice status must always use high-contrast combinations: Paid = Emerald text on Emerald-50 background with Emerald-200 border; Pending = Amber-700 on Amber-50 with Amber-200 border; Overdue = Rose-700 on Rose-50 with Rose-200 border.
Buttons with primary action (Create Invoice, Pay via UPI, Download PDF) must use vibrant purple/indigo with clear white text and visible focus ring.

layouts.dashboard_grid: MODE B - High Density Grid: 4-column KPI cards row (Total Revenue, Paid, Pending, Overdue) followed by an asymmetric 8-col / 4-col breakdown for Live Invoices & Quick UPI Actions / Top Customers.
layouts.invoice_builder_layout: Split-view workflow: Left/Main 8-col editable invoice canvas (Client selector, Invoice dates, HSN/SAC table, GST toggle, dynamic tax slab 0%, 5%, 12%, 18%, 28%) and Right 4-col Live Preview sticky pane with auto-generated Bharat UPI QR code & summary totals.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Crisp 1px borders (border-slate-200/80), gentle layered shadows (shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(15,23,42,0.06),0_10px_20px_rgba(15,23,42,0.03)]), rounded-xl card geometry.
visual_enhancers.upi_qr_component: Clean white card with subtle 1px border, central high-contrast SVG/Canvas QR code with instant 'Copy UPI Link' and 'Open UPI App' button triggers.
visual_enhancers.gst_breakdown_pill: Explicit CGST (9%) + SGST (9%) or IGST (18%) computed tag next to the total to give genuine Indian tax compliance trust.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Tactile, illustrated empty states with quick-action shortcut buttons (e.g. 'Create First Invoice' or 'Import Sample Client').

app_hero_cover.description: Professional modern laptop workplace for authentication side-panel and marketing hero illustration

business_owner_avatar.description: Indian small business owner / artisan profile avatar

1_auth.description: Login / Signup with Role selection (Admin/Business Owner vs Team Member/Billing Staff), remember-me toggle, fast mock switch for testing.

2_dashboard.description: High-density overview with 4 financial KPI cards (Total Invoiced, Total Collected, Pending Dues, Overdue), Monthly Revenue Bar/Area Chart, Recent Invoices quick table, Quick Action triggers ('New Invoice', 'Add Customer', 'Generate Fast UPI Link').

3_invoice_management.description: Full invoice list with search by client name / invoice number, status filter tabs (All, Paid, Pending, Overdue, Draft), date ranges, bulk actions, and sorting.

4_invoice_builder.description: Stateful dynamic invoice creator. Includes auto-incremented invoice number, Client selector or quick-add modal, Issue & Due dates, Multi-item table with Description, HSN/SAC code, Qty, Unit Price, GST Rate slab (0%, 5%, 12%, 18%, 28%), Auto-calculated CGST/SGST/IGST breakdown, Discount %, Notes & Bank/UPI details footer.

5_invoice_detail_and_upi_payment.description: Clean, print-ready digital invoice sheet with dynamic UPI QR Code (upi://pay?pa=...&pn=...&am=...&cu=INR), 'Copy UPI Payment Link', 'Mark as Paid' modal with payment mode (UPI, NEFT/IMPS, Cash, Cheque) & transaction reference, PDF download & WhatsApp share button.

6_customer_management.description: Customer directory with Business name, Contact Person, Phone, Email, Billing Address, GSTIN, Total Invoices count, and Total Outstanding balance.

7_business_settings.description: Business Profile setup: Business Name, Trade Name, GSTIN, Business Type, Primary UPI ID (e.g. business@okaxis / business@ybl), Bank Details (A/C number, IFSC, Branch), Default Invoice Prefix & Terms.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.data_testid_policy: All interactive buttons, input elements, dropdown triggers, status indicators, and modal triggers MUST contain explicit kebab-case `data-testid` attributes as specified in the test_ids map.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.currency_formatting: All amounts must use the Indian Currency Numbering standard (e.g., ₹1,25,000.00 instead of ₹125,000.00) using `new Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', { style: 'currency', currency: 'INR' }).format(val)`.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.upi_link_generation: Generate dynamic standard UPI payment intent URIs: `upi://pay?pa=${encodeURIComponent(upiId)}&pn=${encodeURIComponent(businessName)}&am=${amount}&cu=INR&tn=Invoice%20${encodeURIComponent(invoiceNumber)}` and render high quality QR code using `qrcode.react` or an SVG QR component.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.gst_compliance: Support Indian GST calculation with intra-state (CGST + SGST) vs inter-state (IGST) automatic computation toggle based on customer state vs business state.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.toasts_and_feedback: Use `sonner` for instant user feedback upon invoice creation, payment recording, link copy, and settings updates.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.responsive_collapsible_nav: Desktop persistent dark slate sidebar with quick business profile summary and clean active indicators; Mobile bottom sheet or slide-over drawer.
